title: Bounded Buoyancy: stable, accurate buoyancy for Godot and Unity
description:
Stable, accurate buoyancy for game and simulation engines: plugins for Godot 4.4+ and for Unity 2022.3 LTS and Unity 6, in 3D and 2D. The added mass of the water a body displaces goes into its inertia every physics step, so buoyancy drives no fall faster than g and no rise faster than g/C, for every density, and the first frame after a release is the classical value. Bodies of any shape tilt and right themselves; water volumes have waves and currents, or float bodies on the waves of another water system (an ocean shader in Godot, HDRP's Water System in Unity); air, balloons and thin air, wind with gusts and sails, splashes, and a 2D version are included, with tests that reproduce the benchmarks of the companion paper.

Companion paper: Parkyn, N. (2026). Bounded Buoyancy: Added Mass and Two Ceilings for Stable, Accurate Buoyancy in Game and Simulation Engines, v1.1. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23304509. Companion to ValerieX (VXXX): The Density-State Drive, v2.2. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23304469.
